description: This file defines utility functions for working with source positions in Go ASTs, specifically providing the PathEnclosingInterval function to find AST nodes enclosing a given source interval.

methods.name: PathEnclosingInterval
methods.description: Returns the AST nodes enclosing a specified source interval, along with whether the match is exact.

methods.name: NodeDescription
methods.description: Provides a human-readable description of an AST node type.
